_about: Shared by both baselines (docs/baselines/authoring_spec.md, 'Item descriptions for pick'): per kind of item, keyed by its equipment-catalogue name (interaction.json objects[*].item, the name manifest.inventory and the capability contracts use), pick's `target` and `part` and place's `release_constraint`. Written from the catalogue record (openral_ext/capability_server/contracts.py item_catalogue on the asset's .json: carry_handle, grasp_interface.contact_region / engagement / release_constraint) and the item's look (space_robotics_bench/assets/lunar_base/previews/<asset>_*.png). Read by baselines/europa/host.py and, through the adapter Lookup ItemDescription, by baselines/plexil/plans/MissionB_Covered.ple.
